pre_fix_observation.note: This diagnostic preceded the final two boundary-regression cases and is not a same-case metric delta.

changes: Latin route terms now require token boundaries, preventing api in rapid and redis in redistribution from causing false project routes.

The literature vocabulary now covers curated-corpus language including SAOS, BreakPro, rheometer, shear rate, plug flow, wall slip, yielding liquids, solid volume fraction, DOI, and research/review paper intent.
Ambiguous or balanced queries remain unforced and search all corpora. Explicit corpus filters still take precedence.
limitations: The routing labels evaluate corpus intent, not semantic answer relevance.
The 32 cases are repository-maintained regression cases, not production traffic.
Corpus purity follows from metadata filtering and does not prove that the returned chunks answer the query.
